__comment: SEED / test-grade spec fixtures for the G3 background-job lane (po-av01j.4): RC-060 background-process safety plus the job-altitude re-application of the existing timeout judgment (same machinery, new sites, declared via site_kinds). PRODUCTION corpus authoring rides the LLM factory and is HITL - these entries exist so the e2e tests exercise real verdicts, nothing more. The rq.Queue entry deliberately declares NO site_kinds: it is the classic-call-site control proving a G1 spec never decides a background_job site.

apis.rationale: SEED RC-060: a cron-registered job runs unattended against shared stores; the registration is the altitude where a run bound must exist (job-altitude re-application of the timeout judgment)
SEED RC-060: a ticker drives a worker loop only when ranged over; whether that loop mutates shared stores needs per-site judgment
SEED RC-060: celery bounds a task at its registration decorator (@shared_task(time_limit=...)); job-altitude re-application of the timeout judgment
SEED RC-060: app-bound celery registration, same decorator bound as shared_task
SEED job-altitude timeout: a bullmq dispatch accepts a per-job timeout option at the call
SEED applicability control: authored for classic call sites only (no site_kinds), so a background_job site with this api key must abstain, never inherit the judgment
